### ilgAddRecentFiles

`ilgAddRecentFiles( l_fileList ) => t`

```text
                     Cadence SKILL Development Reference
                              SKILL IDE Functions


ilgAddRecentFiles
ilgAddRecentFiles(
     l_fileList
     )
     => t


Description

Adds the files listed in l_fileList to the SKILL IDE File menu.


Arguments

l_fileList                 The list of files to be added to the SKILL IDE File menu.


Value Returned

t                          The listed files were successfully added to the SKILL IDE File
                           menu.


Example
ilgAddRecentFiles('("loop2.il"))
=>t
```
